accepted_conventions.note: Intro backstory (Durga, the murder 20 years ago, the rebirth) plays over present-day palace/confrontation shots. The murder has no footage in this excerpt except the B&W flashback shown later (L56-L59). This is the Movie Gyaan intro pattern: backstory recap over the opening shots, ending on the hook.
Teaser question plays over the final somber shot of Durga + Bindiya — the genre's ending pattern (teaser, not summary).

Identifies the B&W fight as the first-birth murder of Karan/Arjun. The shot shows a B&W fight with horsemen; the identification comes from the film's known story (Karan Arjun 1995) and the flashback's placement. Story-grounded, not invented.

Longest remaining freezes (L04 6.50s on the rebirth backstory close-up; L25 5.01s on Durga+Sonia close-up; L26 4.00s on Durga+Munshiji). No clean adjacent free shot matches without repeating a used shot or contradicting the narration, so the held frame is accepted as a still-photo-style beat over the narration, per the brief (hold the last frame, never borrow the next scene).
